title: Law requiring disability training for health care providers
summary: This bill would require the city's health department to develop disability competency training, clinical guidance and educational resources on accessible care, in consultation with disability groups and the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities. Health and Hospitals employees would be offered the training, and the department must publish resources online and report annually on implementation starting two years after the law takes effect. The law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
